name: NFC and NFD spellings of one name on the drive: a macOS or Windows disk gets one and lists the other, both stay on the drive
description: KOOFR-009 (Koofr, names compared after normalization): an NFC and an NFD spelling of one name in one folder became '<name> (Unicode Encoding Conflict)'. Rules P2 and P1: the original bytes are stored, names are compared in NFC, a disk that ignores normalization gets one and lists the other (name-collision); the outcome is the same on every pass, never a rename loop. sync-chaos port-nfc-nfd, port-linux-nfd-distinct.
